name: Workbench P-001 isolated Zellij session-tab binding
summary: The maintained live smoke passed 14 assertions against an isolated real Zellij 0.44.3 session and the rebuilt WASM plugin. Only the new centered terminal received the canonical launch binding; an existing identical command in another tab stayed unbound. Display-name restoration and close cleanup passed. This is Linux current-build terminal evidence, not three-OS installed-app acceptance or shipment.

runtime.isolation: Unique pui-smoke-2281710 session, private XDG directories and permission cache, test-owned PTY; driver tears down its own session and temporary directories.

provenance.timestampSource: Retained completed CommandExecution record with exit_code 0, started_at_ms 1793957459595 and completed_at_ms 1793957474524.
provenance.recordingMethod: Recovered the completed command and unchanged output from the predecessor transcript and filesystem; did not rerun passing checks to reconstruct proof.

rootCause: Zellij 0.44.3 creates the tab but returns no new tab IDs; binding only IDs returned by that host call silently omitted the actual command's launch identity.
recurrenceGuard: The maintained live-smoke.py drives a real tab creation with a same-command negative control in another tab and checks exact binding, focus, display-name restoration and close lifecycle. Plugin native unit tests separately cover the unique parsed KDL marker fallback.
